reason: Upgrading `client-go` and `kvproto` is not a routine local fix when it requires source changes in core KV/transaction driver paths. The touched files (`pkg/kv/kv.go` and multiple `pkg/store/driver/txn/*` files) sit on central storage and transaction execution boundaries, so small adaptation mistakes can cause high-blast-radius correctness issues in batch get, transaction behavior, or KV consistency. Even with a small code count, this combination of dependency upgrade plus edits in core `kv`/`store` paths is risky enough to justify a focused deep review.
